**A sentence has been given in Direct/Indirect Speech. Out of the four given alternatives, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in**** ****Indirect/Direct Speech.** 

The beggar exclaimed, “will none of you help me?”

options.text: The beggar asked to help him.
The beggar exclaimed whether none of them would help him.
The beggar exclaimed would none of them helped him.
The beggar exclaimed whether they would help him.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'The beggar exclaimed whether none of them would help him.'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Direct Speech. As per the question, we have to change it into Indirect Speech.
 
• While changing the narration of an **interrogative** sentence, we make the following changes:
 
 
• 'Said to' is changed to 'told + object' whereas 'said' remains as it is.
 
• The first person (I/We) changes according to the subject__ and the second person (You) changes according to the object.
 
• The conjunction 'that' is used __in place of commas and inverted commas__.
 
• In the given sentence, the verb **'exclaimed' **is used hence this verb will remain the same.
 
 

So the correct sentence is- 'The beggar exclaimed whether none of them would help him.'

questions.question:
**The question below consists of a set of labelled sentences. Out of the four**** ****options given, select the most logical order of the sentences to form a**** ****coherent paragraph.** 

Next to the Punjabi 

A – clad in beautiful sarees 

B – family was a group from Chennai in 

C – which all the women were
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'BCA'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Punjabi is an adjective→ that must be followed by a noun. 
 
• Hence, 'family' should be the noun that is followed by this adjective. 
 
• After the preposition, we need to write a prepositional object that can be a noun/pronoun/gerund/noun phrase/noun clause. 'which all the women were' is the correct noun clause for the prepositional object. Hence it will be the second part.
 
• So the correct sentence is- ***Next to the Punjabi family was a group from Chennai in which all the women were clad in beautiful sarees.***

questions.question:
The following equation is incorrect. Which two signs should be interchanged to correct the equation?

2 - 10 × 6 + 5 = 22

questions.solution:

1 # 4 → (1 - 4) × 10 = -30

Similarly,

4 # 9 → (4 - 9) × 10 = -50

Hence, the correct answer is **"- 50".**

questions.question:
In the question, two statements are given followed by two conclusions I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statement I:** All potatoes are chips.

**Statement II: **All French fries are potatoes.

**Conclusion I:** No chips are French fries.

**Conclusion II:** Some French fries are chips.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e461976c5bdc573d113129f186b5aa15df5ee03162c60a4ddb4478fe2c0f28cb.png] 

No chips are French fries → **Doesn't Follows** (as, all potatoes are chips and all French fries are potatoes)

Some French fries are chips → **Follows** (as, all potatoes are chips and all French fries are potatoes)

Hence, the correct answer is** "only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question: Compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at the rate of 11% per annum is Rs. 1160.5. What will be the simple interest (in Rs) for the same amount at the same rate of interest for 2 years?

⇒ 0.2321P = 1160.5

Now,

Simple interest = (5000 × 11 × 2) /100

= 1100

questions.question: If Shubhangi walks at a speed of 2 km/hr, then she reaches her school 5/2 minutes late but if she walks at a speed of 2.5 km/hr, then she reaches 5 minutes before the scheduled time. What is the distance (in km) of her school from her house?
questions.solution:
Calculation:

Let the actual time taken by t mins

Now,

Speed = 2km/hr = (2/60) km/min = (1/30) km/min

Time taken = t + (5/2) mins

Distance = (1/30) × {t + (5/2)} km

Also,

Speed = 2.5 km/hr = (2.5/60) km/min = (1/24) km/min

Time taken = (t – 5) mins

Distance = (1/24) × (t – 5) km

Now,

(1/30) × {t + (5/2)} = (1/24) × (t – 5)

⇒ (t/4) – (t/5) = (1/2) + (5/4)

⇒ t/20 = 7/4

⇒ t = 35 mins

**∴ Distance = (1/30) × {35 + (5/2)} = 75/60 = 1.25 km**

questions.question: What does cyclical unemployment mean?

options.text: Unemployment during recessionary phase of trade cycle

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __Unemployment during the recessionary phase of the trade cycle.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• Unemployment occurs when a person who is actively searching for employment is unable to find work.
 
• It is often used as a measure of the health of the economy. 
 
• Types of Unemployment
 
• Disguised Unemployment:
 
 
• The phenomenon is when more people are employed than actually needed. 
 
• Example: agricultural and the unorganized sectors of India.
 
 
 
• Seasonal Unemployment:
 
 
• Unemployment occurs during certain seasons of the year.
 
• Example: Agricultural labourers.
 
 
 
• Structural Unemployment:
 
 
• Unemployment arising from the mismatch between the jobs and the skills of the available workers in the market. 
 
• Many people do not get jobs due to a lack of requisite skills and due to the poor educational level.
 
 
 
• Cyclical Unemployment:
 
 
• It is the result of the business cycle. 
 
• Unemployment rises during recessions and declines with economic growth. 
 
 
 
• ​Technological Unemployment:
 
 
• It is the loss of jobs due to changes in technology.
 
 
 
• ​Frictional Unemployment:
 
 
• Frictional Unemployment is also known as Search Unemployment. 
 
• It refers to the time lag between jobs when an individual is searching for a new job or is switching between jobs.
 
 
 
• ​Vulnerable Employment:
 
 
• This means people are working informally without proper job contracts.
 
• These persons are deemed ‘unemployed’ since records of their work are never maintained.

 __

questions.question: Which of the following has become the first country in the world to pay equal salary to men and women?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Iceland.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Iceland** became the first nation to** impose equal pay **for **men and women.**
 
• The new law became effective on **January 1st, 2018.**
 
• According to the law, businesses and government organizations that **employ at least 25 individuals** must get government certification of their** equal pay practices**.
 
• If businesses cannot demonstrate that men and women are paid equally for the same job, they** risk fines.**
 
• The **World Economic Forum** has placed Iceland as the **top country in the world **for gender equality for **nine years** running prior to the passage of this law.
 
• Iceland was already a **global leader** in** gender parity. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In terms of** international cricket, India** is now only the **second nation** to adopt equal pay.
 
• A** "pay equity policy"** was recently announced by the **Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).**
 
• The centrally contracted** men's and women's players** would get the same match fees, according to policy.
 
• The **Global Gender Gap Index 2022** estimates that it will take** 132 years **to achieve full parity at the current rate of development.
 
• In **2022, New Zealand Cricket (NZC)** and the country's players' organisation reached an agreement that allowed **female cricketers** to receive **salaries on par **with those of **male players.**
 
• **Tennis** has taken steps to increase pay equity for its players.
 
• All** four major tennis tournaments **now **offer equal prize** money to their male and female competitors.

questions.question: _______ of species is a reflection of their evolutionary relationships.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Classification.**__

__Concept:__

__
 
• Classification is not a single-step process, it involves a hierarchy of steps in which each step represents a rank or category.
 
• This category is a part of the overall taxonomic arrangement so it is called the taxonomic category, and all these categories together constitute the taxonomic hierarchy.
 
• Taxonomic hierarchy - It is the process of arranging various organisms into successive levels of the biological classification either in a decreasing or an increasing order from kingdom to species and vice versa.

EXPLANATION:__

 
• Classification of species is a reflection of their evolutionary relationships.

questions.question: What is the name of the technology developed by Australian scientists to transform soybean oil into graphene?
questions.solution:
• GraphAir is the technology that has been developed by Australian Scientists to transform soybean oil into graphene.
 
• This technology grows graphene film with a natural precursor in ambient air, thus making its production simpler and faster.

questions.question: In August 2017, who launched ‘S&P BSE Bharat 22 Index’?
questions.solution: ‘S&P BSE Bharat 22 Index’ was launched by Asia Index in August 2017 in order to track the performance of select state-run companies in which the central government has divested its stake.

questions.question: An earthquake of magnitude 6 on Richter scale has ________ times more destructive energy than an earthquake of magnitude 4.
questions.solution:
• An earthquake of magnitude 6 on Richter scale has hundred times more destructive energy than an earthquake of magnitude 4.
 
• The Richter scale is a base 10 logarithmic scale which is used to measure the magnitude of the earthquake.
 
• This means that an earthquake with magnitude 6 would be 10 times stronger than magnitude 5 and 100 times stronger than magnitude 4.

questions.question: Find the kinetic energy (in J) possessed by a body of mass 10 kg moving with a velocity of 5 m/s.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**125**__.

__**CALCULATION:**__

Mass (m) = 10 kg and Velocity (v) = 5 m/s

Kinetic energy = 1/2 mv²

= 1/2x10x5² 

=** 125 J**
